enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Lie still. Breathe slowly.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Open shower curtain. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve eggs onto plate. Place plate on table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse plate. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Lay clothes on bed. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Pack laptop. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office. Open office door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit office as community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Prepare documents. Print documents. Attend another meeting. Discuss program plans. Update schedule. Organize files. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to desk. Continue working. Check emails. Make more calls. Leave office.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Place plate on table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse plate. Turn off tap.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open project file. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Scroll. Save file. Open browser. Search for information. Read article. Take notes. Close browser. Continue typing. Save file. Shut down laptop. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rub face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Lie still. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Sleep.
